keymaps.cause: A stock Xvfb 21.1.12-1ubuntu1.9 (also the Noble release build) resets its keyboard to the compiled default when its last client disconnects; setxkbmap is that last client, so a bare setxkbmap then xkbcomp -xkb :97 reads US again (the server compiles pc+de then pc+us). With -noreset, or any long-lived X client, the layout stays. The maintained route has openbox connected before the native step.
